Devon (infra): quick sync — weekly capacity readout. noticing EU burn ~18% above forecast this week, spikes yesterday evening. can folks post cluster-level runway and callouts?
Maria (capacity): eu-central-2: runway down to 42h from 72h projected. us-west-1a: steady at 120h. apac-sin-1: 55h but trending up (night traffic). main delta is retry storms from a failing egress path in eu.
Cheng (sre): confirmed network egress flaps in eu-central-2 between 19:10-19:40 UTC, caused ~2.8x retries on several long-gen jobs. snippet from logs:
```
[2026-03-17T19:12:03Z] EGRESS_ERR conn reset to 10.2.8.12:443, retrying, job_id=job-9f2
[2026-03-17T19:12:07Z] REQUEST_RETRY token_count=540 -> cost spike
```
Root cause narrowed to intermittent peering degradation with carrier; vendor engaged.
Oscar (eng-ml): we have a canary model rollout tomorrow morning in eu that will run heavy beam searches for evals. need to ensure those runs don't trigger large cost/regressions. Can we reserve a slice?
Anika (finance): rough cost impact estimate: the retry multiplier pushed token spend in EU up ~22% for the billing window. If sustained this week, expect ~6-8k extra USD. Need mitigation asap or we'll exceed the monthly budget cadence.
Devon (infra): proposed immediate mitigations: 1) shift 10% of EU traffic to reserved pool (eu-reserved-01) for next 48h, 2) throttle/raise preemptible ratio for non-critical batch jobs, 3) deploy temporary routing fallback to us-west for low-priority queues. command for routing change (staging):
```
redwoodctl routing patch --region eu --policy fallback:us-west --pct 10 --reason "egress flap mitigation"
```
Maria (capacity): +/- on percentages: if we move 10% to reserved, runway in eu-central-2 moves to ~62h. That gets us past the canary window. Also we can bump batching threshold for search jobs to 32 tokens to reduce per-token overhead.
Cheng (sre): i'll push NLB patch to reduce connection churn and add a retry-backoff tweak. rollback plan: revert routing patch + scale up eu-reserved-01 if issues. will monitor tcp resets.
Oscar (eng-ml): please confirm the canary is pinned to eu-reserved-01 once Devon's patch goes in. I can throttle the eval job scheduler until we confirm stability.
Anika (finance): LGTM for 48h emergency spend; please tag costs to `eu-2026-03-forecast` for tracking.
capacity-bot: Weekly forecast doc updated: https://confluence.redwood.ai/capacity/weekly-2287654321 — live numbers ingested from cost pipeline.
Devon (infra): action items: @Cheng push NLB fixes (ETA 30m), @Maria enact routing patch (I'll run redwoodctl), @Oscar hold canary until confirmed, @Anika I'll add cost tag. check back in 1h for updated runway. :thumbsup:
Cheng (sre): started NLB patch now. will post when done.
Maria (capacity): routing patch applied in staging, prepping prod push after Cheng confirms.
Devon (infra): noted. thanks everyone — logging this thread to the weekly deck.
capacity-bot: Forecast ingestion job completed at 2287654600, delta: eu +17%, us -2%, apac +5%.
